name: Creamy Chicken-Corn Chowder with Asparagus, Carrot, Celery & Parsley

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove chicken to a plate. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium carrots
4 sticks celery
1 small bunch asparagus
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.

Return pot (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into bite-sized pieces. Place in the reserved bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the asparagus and set aside. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
When the veggies are tender, add flour to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until veggies are well coated, about 1 minute.

Return cooked chicken to the pot, then add asparagus, parsley, broth, and corn. Stir to combine the chowder and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until asparagus is tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
2 cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Add cream to the pot, stir to combine, and continue to cook until warmed through, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 8 fl oz (1 cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chowder between bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
